scope: Synthetic complete/incomplete/mismatched-pair JSON fixtures and temporary lock only. No real held-out metrics or frozen sources altered.
interpretation: Loss is mean nats per target byte converted by log(2); all windows have32 targets, so window-count weighting equals target-count weighting.
Fitted seeds are averaged first, then full documents resampled with their window sums/counts; this preserves within-document dependence rather than independently bootstrapping windows.
Interval is conditional on three fitted seeds and observed cohort, not uncertainty from training reruns or arbitrary population/architecture sampling. Across-seed sample SD is separately reported.
900s paired interval omitted unless all3 paired seeds exist; no incomplete-cohort point estimate substituted.
Manifest groups must align with per-example arrays; evaluator generates matching order. More explicit array-length/unique-seed assertions would harden malformed external artifact handling.
No inference about general intelligence, GPU performance or 600B transfer is justified.
